features.name: Sustainability Value Entry
features.description: New functionality tracking item emissions similar to existing value entries but related to item emissions instead of costs. Created when posting purchase invoices and assembly orders with value chain tracking enabled.
caveats: Only works with carbon equivalent
Item charge cannot be applied in this wave
Only supports average costing method

features.name: Value Chain Tracking Field
features.description: Required field in Sustainability Setup that must be enabled to create sustainability value entries alongside sustainability ledger entries when posting purchase invoices.
caveats: Functionality is in public review
Users should test in sandbox first before production
Without enabling shows no difference in user experience

features.name: Manual Emissions Entry for Existing Items
features.description: Ability to manually enter emissions for items that do not have purchase documents. Users can enter carbon, methane and natrium values and run a calculate CO2 action to compute carbon equivalent.
caveats: Only applies if no purchase document exists
Manual entry only for existing items without purchase history

features.name: Automatic Emissions Collection from Purchase Documents
features.description: System automatically collects emission information from posted purchase invoices and calculates carbon equivalent in the background for items used in assembly orders.
caveats: Only for items with purchase documents
Automatic calculation based on configured emission fees

features.name: Assembly Order Emissions Calculation
features.description: Assembly orders now calculate total carbon equivalent based on component items and resources, showing total and per-unit emissions. System automatically transfers emissions from assembly lines to final assembly item.
caveats: Only item charges not supported in this wave
Item charge application planned for future
Works only with average costing method

features.name: Carbon Equivalent Calculation
features.description: System calculates carbon equivalent from multiple gas emissions (carbon, methane, natrium) using configured emission fees. Works as the basis for all value chain calculations.
caveats: Only carbon equivalent is used for value chain calculations
Can track individual gases but calculations use equivalent
Requires emission fee configuration

features.name: Sustainability Ledger Entry
features.description: Existing functionality that records sustainability transactions. Now works alongside sustainability value entries when value chain tracking is enabled.
caveats: Created even without value chain tracking enabled
Earlier way of recording sustainability transactions

features.name: Sustainability Value Entry on Sales Invoice
features.description: Final solution to include sustainability value entry information on sales invoices. Emissions from assembly orders will appear on the sales invoice document.
caveats: Currently no printout support - must be added manually
Future printout support based on feedback
Currently only in posted sales invoice document

features.name: Procurement Fast Tab in Sustainability Setup
features.description: Configuration area in Sustainability Setup where users enable value chain tracking and default sustainability accounts and emission values for items and resources.
caveats: Must enable value chain tracking field
Requires configuration of default values
